title: Invoice
brief:
An invoice from Orbit Labs, a printed document on one A4 page, as a PDF.

- All text in Inter (`fontFamily: "Inter"`).
- Heading: "Invoice INV-2026-014"
- Text: "Issued November 8, 2026. Due December 8, 2026."
- Text: "Bill to: Northwind Traders, 12 Harbor Rd, Portland, OR 97209"
- A table with a header row "Item", "Qty", "Price", then a row per item, prices aligned to the right:
  - "Design review", "1", "$1,200.00"
  - "Template build", "3", "$2,400.00"
  - "Support hours", "10", "$950.00"
- Under the items, "Subtotal" "$4,550.00", "Tax" "$364.00" and a bold "Total" "$4,914.00", each amount's right edge lined up with the prices'.
- Last, a line: "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco. Questions: billing@orbit.dev"
